children.title: SOC 2
lines: Audit standard for SaaS operations (security, availability, confidentiality) - proof-of-controls report by an independent CPA firm.

children.title: HIPAA
lines: US law protecting health data (PHI); mandatory for healthcare workloads.

children.title: PCI-DSS
lines: Payment card industry security standard; mandatory for anything touching card data (including your token-budget/billing flows).

children.title: NIST CSF
lines: US framework catalog for security programs; the "N" in many evidence-pack exports.

children.title: CIS Benchmarks
lines: Center for Internet Security best-practice configuration catalogs (e.g., AWS Foundations Benchmark) that posture tools score against.

children.title: GDPR / DSGVO
lines: EU data protection law - the reason security tooling must prove what it stores, not just that it stores it.
